'''Phelarion''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. In was the homeworld of the wealthy [[Motti family]], which included figures prominent in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] such as [[Thalassa Tarkin|Lady Thalassa Tarkin]], wife of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], and [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The Motti family were wealthy citizens in the [[Megonite moss/Legends|megonite moss]] mining business, established in the centuries prior to [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]], using [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor.

Lady Tarkin erected a solid black obelisk on Phelarion in tribute to Tarkin and named the main starport [[Port Tarkin]]. She ran the mining operations for the Empire, but they were sabotaged by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], who crashed on the planet after her ship was shot down by a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]].
